stories.headline: Asian governments move to stem stock slide after Wall Street plunge
stories.summary: China eased margin requirements to 80% to boost stock liquidity, while Taiwan and South Korea rolled out intervention measures including activation of a stock stabilization fund, after a sharp Wall Street selloff rattled global markets. The coordinated response follows a week of heavy losses in Asian equities tied to AI-stock weakness.

stories.headline: South Korea unveils phased market stabilization measures
stories.summary: South Korean financial officials held an emergency meeting and announced staged measures, including activation of a stock stabilization fund, to calm volatile markets amid the broader Asia selloff.

stories.headline: China's $1.7 trillion AI stock rally turns into a losing trade
stories.summary: Chinese AI stocks that rallied as the nation's tech firms pursued parity with the US have reversed sharply, erasing roughly $1.7 trillion in value and turning what had been a hot trade into a loser for investors.

stories.headline: Metals markets rocked by a week of short squeezes and meltdown
stories.summary: Copper and broader metals markets saw a volatile week featuring short squeezes followed by a sharp selloff. Sentiment at Shanghai industry gatherings turned bearish on the demand outlook, with traders weighing fresh short positions.

stories.headline: Goldman Sachs, Apollo price $32 billion in SpaceX bonds to fund AI chip purchases
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs and Apollo priced $32 billion of bonds tied to SpaceX, structured to help finance the company's purchases of AI chips without straining its balance sheet. The deal is being framed as a template for financing the broader AI buildout via debt markets.

stories.headline: California Nvidia probe expands to cover potential criminal violations
stories.summary: California's investigation into whether Nvidia illegally sold advanced chips to China and misled investors is now also examining potential criminal violations of state law, raising the legal stakes for the chipmaker.

stories.headline: CrowdStrike-Zscaler talks highlight AI-driven cybersecurity consolidation
stories.summary: Reported talks between CrowdStrike and Zscaler point to a wave of multibillion-dollar takeovers reshaping cybersecurity, as the largest firms race to bolster defenses against increasingly sophisticated AI-powered attacks.

stories.headline: US consumers keep spending heading into holiday season despite inflation worries
stories.summary: Anxiety about inflation has not yet curbed US consumer spending as the holiday shopping season approaches, according to Bloomberg Economics, a signal that household demand remains resilient despite price pressures.
